description: ENGINEERING/AUDIT view — the run's DECISION timeline: an ordered milestone list projected from the event log — stages (with trigger and a 'changedFromPrevious' marker when a stage was recomputed), skeptic escalations (with the reason), the verdict(s) (with the reviewer's head note), screen-gates, and the terminal outcome. Answers 'how did the verdict evolve?' in one call; for 'what did it find', call brief instead.

runId.description: The run's full runId (slug-date-codename) OR just its codename.
